lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\OIDCLogin\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
19 uses of the private API of the server in 6 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer is in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.
